title: Day and Night
summary: The spinning Earth, sunrise in the east, and why it is night in America when it is day in India.

cbse.chapter: Our Wondrous World (2025) Ch 9: Rhythms of Nature

objectives: I can explain day and night using the spinning Earth.
I can say where the Sun rises and sets.
I can explain why different countries have day at different times.
misconceptions: The Sun moves round the Earth every day.
At night the Sun goes out.
It is daytime everywhere at the same time.
